claim: In the matching retail DLL, static MyMusic.Check_File(Int32 index) (0x06002C20) has exact signature blob 00010208 and an exact 73-byte body. It computes local0 = index - raw 10000. If local0 is below raw 0 it returns false. It then reads MyMusic.FileList_Match.Count and returns false when Count is raw 0. It reads Count again and branches to the lookup only when the exact bge operand order succeeds for Count and local0; otherwise it returns false. The lookup loads FileList_Match[local0], reads MySound_FileList.name, calls the already-canonical MyMusic.Check_File(String) token 0x06002C1E, and returns that Boolean. The direct String-overload call is at IL+0x0043.
